name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at yesterday's value area — price only (reference)
why: Stops cluster just beyond yesterday's value area; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.

scan.when: !rollwin && ((hi(5,1) > pvah && cl(5,1) < pvah) || (lo(5,1) < pval && cl(5,1) > pval))
scan.dir: (lo(5,1) < pval && cl(5,1) > pval) - (hi(5,1) > pvah && cl(5,1) < pvah)
